sentences.en: A life without you. I can't imagine it.

sentences.en:
Um, I…
Okay, how about… Will you marry me?

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.speaker: narrator

Would you consider marriage,
on a trial basis?

sentences.en: Thus, on one night at the dining table, a question that crossed the boundary between contract and emotion was placed.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.speaker: narrator
